title: HenkaRecord
description: A single change-point record appended to henka-register.jsonl. Encodes henkaten classification per the 4M taxonomy (§6) and v2 revisions R1/R2/R4/R6/R8.

henka_id.description: Unique identifier for this change-point record. Format: HK-NNNN.

sprint_context.description: Sprint number during which this change-point was detected.

fourM_axis.description: Primary 4M classification axis for this change point. R8.

category.description: Sub-type within the 4M axis (e.g. agent-capability-change, scope-change). Validated against built-in 13 sub-types + custom_henkaten_categories from config.

change_origin.description: active = deliberately initiated (henkoten 変更点); passive = emerged unbidden (henkaten 変化点 strict sense). Passive changes default to lower confidence/impact unless corroborated by a second signal. R1.

impact_level.description: Impact classification: informational (log-only) → actionable (attend) → blocking (halt) → high-risk (stop immediately).

description.description: Human-readable description of the change point.

affected_artifacts.description: File paths or artifact identifiers affected by this change.

response_type.description: How this change-point should be handled.

evidence.description: Evidence items supporting this classification. Each observed claim must carry a re-runnable verification command (R4).

evidence_class.description: observed = directly witnessed and verifiable; inferred = derived from observed claims; speculative = hypothesis only.

verification.description: A re-runnable command conformant with the §4.5 verification syntax allowlist (e.g. 'git log --oneline -5', 'grep -r pattern src/', 'cat file.json | jq .field'). Required when evidence_class is 'observed'.

source_file.description: Source file path where this evidence was found.

andon_signal.description: Optional. Present if the agent that detected this Henkaten issued an andon signal (R2, §7.0.1).

type.description: alert = recoverable, takt-bounded; stop = committed halt requiring user resume.

reason.description: Concise statement of what triggered the signal.

evidence.description: File:line or command output references supporting the signal.

swarm_request.description: Agent IDs suggested for swarm dispatch. Orchestrator decides final composition.

yokoten.description: Optional. Populated by retrospective agent when status transitions to closed. Encodes learning propagation (R6, §2.6 Pillar 6).

applicable_to_subsequent_sprints.description: Sprint identifiers this learning applies to, or ['all'] for all remaining sprints.

adaptation_notes.description: Guidance for how this learning translates to subsequent sprints. NOT a verbatim copy — adapt the principle, not the exact fix.

deployed_to.description: Sprints where this learning was applied.

sprint.description: Sprint identifier where learning was deployed.

decision_id.description: DEC-NNNN identifier of the ratification decision.

adaptation_taken.description: Brief description of how the learning was adapted.

status.description: Lifecycle status of this change-point record.

detected_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this change-point was detected.

detected_by_agent.description: Agent ID that detected this change-point.

closed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was closed.

resolution_summary.description: Brief summary of how the change-point was resolved.
